system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Rice Energy Inc. / Alpha Natural Resources proposed asset acquisition, realized record

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier records ONLY the realized fate of
> the transaction and its record over the fixed outcome window. It contains no information
> about how the transaction was structured. Outcome window fixed at construction: the
> realized record of the transaction over the ~3-5-year horizon after the ~2016 event
> (~2019-2021), bounded per the no-record rule because the registrant ceased to be a
> separate public filer in November 2017 (see below).

## Realized fate of the transaction
- The proposed acquisition did not close. The Company's Form 10-Q for the quarterly period
  ended June 30, 2016 states: "The previously contemplated acquisition of the Marcellus
  and Utica assets in central Greene County, Pennsylvania from a subsidiary of Alpha
  Natural Resources, Inc. for $200.0 million, which was to be funded by the net proceeds
  [of the April 2016 Equity Offering], was not consummated, and, as a result, the Company
  intends to use the net proceeds of the April 2016 Equity Offering for general corporate
  purposes, which may include funding a portion of its 2017 capital budget." [SRC: SEC accession 0001588238-16-000044, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2016]
- No assets of Alpha Natural Resources crossed to the Company under this transaction: the
  acquisition was not consummated, so no ownership boundary was crossed. [SRC: SEC accession 0001588238-16-000044, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2016]

## Realized record over the fixed outcome window
- Because the transaction was never consummated, there is no acquired business, and no
  post-close acquired-business outcome scalar (net income/loss, goodwill/asset write-down,
  impairment, or divestiture) attributable to this transaction to report. [SRC: SEC accession 0001588238-16-000044, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2016]
- The registrant ceased to exist as a separate public filer before the ~2019-2021 window:
  on November 13, 2017 the Company became a wholly owned subsidiary of EQT Corporation
  ("EQT") pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated June 19, 2017 (as amended
  October 26, 2017), with a merger subsidiary merging into the Company and the Company then
  merged into EQT RE, LLC (an EQT subsidiary and successor in interest to the Company).
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-068865, Form 8-K Items 2.01/3.01]
- In connection with the merger the Company notified the New York Stock Exchange that
  trading in its common stock should be suspended and its listing removed; a Form 25-NSE
  (notification of removal from listing) was filed on November 13, 2017. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-068865, Form 8-K Item 3.01] [SRC: SEC accession 0000876661-17-000676, Form 25-NSE]
- EQT RE, LLC, as successor in interest to the Company, filed a Form 15-12B on November 24,
  2017 to suspend the Company's Exchange Act reporting obligations; consequently no separate
  annual report (Form 10-K) or other periodic report was filed by the Company for any
  period after fiscal year 2016, and no separate public 3-5-year record exists for the
  ~2019-2021 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-070327, Form 15-12B]

## Outcome coding note
- This is a documented non-consummation, primary-sourced to the Company's Form 10-Q for the
  quarter ended June 30, 2016, not a data gap: the proposed asset acquisition never closed,
  so there is no acquired business and therefore no product/process-interface trajectory
  and no process/organization-interface trajectory to report. The absence of a separate
  ~2019-2021 registrant record is a consequence of the November 2017 merger and
  deregistration, not an unsourced omission. [SRC: SEC accession 0001588238-16-000044, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2016] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-070327, Form 15-12B]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- The proposed $200 million stalking-horse asset acquisition of Alpha Natural Resources'
  Marcellus/Utica Greene County acreage by the Company was not consummated, as the Company
  disclosed in its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2016; no assets crossed the
  ownership boundary and no acquired-business outcome scalar exists. The Company itself was
  acquired by EQT Corporation on November 13, 2017, was delisted from the NYSE, and had its
  Exchange Act reporting obligations suspended via a Form 15-12B filed November 24, 2017,
  so no separate public record exists for the fixed ~2019-2021 outcome window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001588238-16-000044, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2016] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-068865, Form 8-K Items 2.01/3.01] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-070327, Form 15-12B]

[SLICE END]
